hypothesis: The early handoff window is caused by terminal memory-port grant timing rather than a universally early BBUSY event.
competitor: BBUSY or its custom-register sampling becomes visible early independently of CPU grants.
test: Status-first fixed-delay observations with post-read beams,one/two/sixteen-word blits,normal/nasty,no-DMA/four-plane and no-start controls.

outcomes.status differences with equal beams: Constrain status/read sampling separately from CPU grant.
outcomes.beam differences without status differen: Constrain scheduling; do not add a global flag delay.
outcomes.width-dependent pattern: Use neighboring widths to distinguish body-cycle versus terminal release rules.
